description: This file contains utility functions and classes for exporting, manipulating, and packaging PyTorch models and exported programs, including deep copying, graph modifications, and packaging for compilation.

classes.name: _ExportMethod
classes.description: Represents an export method with its overloads and fallbacks.

classes.name: _ExportPackage
classes.description: Manages a collection of exported models/methods, supporting exporting, packaging, and overload definitions.

methods.name: _copy_graph_module_and_signature
methods.description: Deep copies a graph module and its signature, preserving placeholder names.

methods.name: _remove_detach_pass
methods.description: Removes detach nodes from a graph module.

methods.name: _export_forward_backward
methods.description: Decomposes and updates an exported program with forward/backward graph modifications.

methods.name: _sticky_export
methods.description: Wraps a model's forward method to lazily export on first call.
